item.title: Interfacial Anion Activation for Durable Aqueous Zn-Ion Batteries
item.description:

Journal of the American Chemical Society | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in using an allylurea additive to create an anion-rich, water-deficient interfacial region, enabling electric-field-driven anion reduction and allyl cation-mediated conversion of sulfate into ZnS. This forms an organic-inorganic hybrid SEI. Its significance is markedly enhanced interfacial stability, yielding over 2500 h Zn||Zn cycling at 5 mA cm–2 and over 10,000 cycles in full cells.
🏷 aqueous Zn-ion battery · solid electrolyte interphase · allylurea additive · ZnS interphase · anion activation

item.description:

Journal of the American Chemical Society | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in combining multiscale solvent screening with asymmetric electrode dissolution regulation: a solid-state migration-fluorination mechanism at the FeF3 cathode minimizes dissolution, while Al3+ complexation-dissolution-redeposition converts insulating AlF3 into soluble complexes, enabling reversible Al anodes for the first time. Significance: low-polarization, highly reversible F-ion batteries with 2000+ cycle life.
